summary: Added the missing sync command that generated-tree guidance, MCP error text, and docs all reference.
reason: The scaffold references 'lever-pp-cli sync' in missing-store guidance (data_source.go), sync-hint text, and the learnHookSkipList, but generated no command. sync <company> fetches all open postings (mode=json) and persists them under a company-scoped key (postings:<company>) with durability verification before recording sync state. --dry-run short-circuits before any network or store work; --agent/--json emits the standard {meta,results} envelope instead of plain text. Mirrors the greenhouse package's sync command shape.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; live end-to-end: 'lever-pp-cli sync leverdemo' persisted 388 postings, '--data-source local' returns only that company's rows, --dry-run writes nothing, --agent emits a JSON envelope with stored/skipped counts.
